definitions.explanation: For something (mail, packages, etc.) to arrive at a destination.
To extend far enough to touch or attain something.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}が{届|とど}きました。
{手紙|てがみ}がまだ{届|とど}いていません。
{棚|たな}に{手|て}が{届|とど}きません。

notes: This is an intransitive verb. The transitive counterpart is {届|とど}ける (to deliver). Often used with mail ({手紙|てがみ}), packages ({荷物|にもつ}), and emails (メール). Also used figuratively: {声|こえ}が{届|とど}く (one's voice reaches/is heard).
